summary: Describes the problem of source-address-dependent routing from a host's view, covering hosts with multiple interfaces or addresses. It shows example networks to explain why source address selection and next-hop choice matter. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If different roads only allow cars from different towns, you must choose the right road for your plate. This explains why computers need to think about that.

questions: multihomed ipv6 host source address selection
